deep_audit_queue.PROCESS-01: containment fully landed 2026-09-07: Windows KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE fence (7c72df3); Unix pipe-EOF watchdog (a954314) — the host re-enters its own executable as a watchdog (env marker dispatched at the top of main, before tokio) holding the read half of a UnixStream pair; host death closes the pipe and the watchdog kills the watched group only if the leader still answers, so the normal-shutdown disarm never signals; armed only by the product TUI. Supervision ledger (995a457) — execute_invocation records every spawned child via ChildLease (released on every normal exit path after the reap, left behind on crash); compose() reconciles the ledger at startup and clears it before the workspace is reused; pid matching is exact JSON-number and stale dead entries are cleared so a reused pid is never targeted. Validated 2026-09-07 on real Linux (WSL2 Ubuntu): agent-process 40/40 (all six watchdog tests), agent-workspace 132, tool-runtime 229 — the ledger's reconcile now proves it kills an abandoned group-leader child; CI re-runs remain as regression.
